SUMMARY: Lost to internal self-host initiative. Customer prioritized full control, predictable unit cost and ability to run models inside their air-gapped test clusters. Short CRM-style notes below.

- 11/05: AE Aisha intro email; heavy focus on latency tails for in-vehicle assistance and reranking of sensor events.
- 11/19: Discovery; asked about Dedicated pool sizing and autoscale. SRE flagged need for KMS + audit logs and said SaaS contract would need SOC2 + ISO addenda.
- 12/08: Live demo showed 95th p50/p95 estimates for our hosted variants (gpt-compat small/med). Diego did side-by-side run vs their internal benchmark (NVIDIA A100 baremetal).
- 12/20: Security team pushed back — corporate policy wants data residency and full control of KV caches; legal asked about on-prem control plane.
- 01/12: They returned security questionnaire; answer: Redwood hosted lacked required HSM/KMS topology in their region.
- 01/25: Procurement email: company-wide freeze on new SaaS commitments for next 2 quarters.
- 02/14: Final sync: engineering lead summarized decision: 'we're building a vLLM + TGI stack with TensorRT for quantized inference, cheaper at scale and gives us full custody.' Mentioned specific components: k8s, Triton, NVIDIA-TRT, custom batching.

QUOTES / SIGNALS: 'Can't justify a hosted spend if we can get 2-3x lower unit cost by running locally' — Head of ML Ops.

- Share cost model comparison (hosted vs self-host) and a short note about hybrid paths (Dedicated + private control plane).
- Keep them on a 6-month re-engagement cadence; re-open if they hit ops burden or model upgrades.
